channel.title: Trails RG Studio
channel.description: macOS updates for Trails RG Studio (Sparkle)

item.title: Version 1.50.18 (150)
item.description:
New folders and clearer workspace

  • Adds New folder to folder menus with safe name and collision validation.
  • Refreshes the folder tree immediately after creation.
  • Simplifies the Library toolbar with labelled Edit and Tools controls.
  • Improves fullscreen Home layout, workflow hierarchy, card consistency, and desktop navigation.
